CustomField.description: Staging mirror of GiftTransaction.FQS_Stewardship_Status__c. Both fields source their picklist values from the FQS_Stewardship_Status GlobalValueSet so the launcher staging value always matches what lands on the transaction. Written to GiftTransaction.FQS_Stewardship_Status__c on commit.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Status of the follow-up stewardship touch. Set to "Don't Send" to suppress automated stewardship. Distinct from Acknowledgement Status, which tracks the initial thank-you.
CustomField.label: Stewardship Status
